evals.prompt: 怎么审核这个 Agent 的产出？它声称完成了整个多 Phase 计划。
evals.expected_output: Applies the delivery audit: forensic snapshot, irreversible-gate check first, DB/data verification, gate re-runs, exact-command rehearsal, independent subagent, report.

evals.prompt: 它说 migrated to DB，怎么验证？
evals.expected_output: Queries the DB directly (SELECT COUNT per table), compares against source data, checks timestamp signatures and relative connection-string trap.

evals.prompt: 这个长任务是否跑偏了？
evals.expected_output: Maps commits to plan phases, flags scope creep and unrecorded 'implement-time' decisions, watches for commits after the last known one.

evals.prompt: 它报告 tests pass，我要自己验证。
evals.expected_output: Re-runs the full test suite and format itself, records own counts, compares with the agent's report, labels ad-hoc scripts honestly.

evals.expected_output: Routes self-change pre-commit review to ada-requesting-code-review.
